observations.reservoir_description: Karstified dolomitic carbonate; secondary void space is not adequately represented by plug porosity.

measurement_qualifiers.pressure: Published prose does not resolve gauge versus absolute pressure, wellhead versus downhole location, or pressure datum. These observations are not used as a calibrated downhole boundary condition.
measurement_qualifiers.flow: Reference pressure and temperature, operating uptime, and a continuous production time series are not specified. No cumulative production is inferred from 1500 m3/day multiplied by 11 years.
measurement_qualifiers.porosity: Plug measurements are not an effective bulk porosity estimate for karst storage.
measurement_qualifiers.recharge: Replenishment is the authors' interpretation; its magnitude and contributions from connected gas, dissolved transport, aquifer support and generation remain uncalibrated.

unconstrained_model_inputs: Connected reservoir area and pore volume
Geological hydrogen influx and loss rates
model_use: Field-informed research scenarios and numerical comparisons; not a reserve estimate or validated production forecast.
